cost5.text:
Hiding a shape you know

Tap a diagram: it inverts, and the strip's head asks: Hide this shape in every song? — 1 redraw, the strip only.
Hide: the strip loses it; if the song's busiest page now needs fewer rows, the chart takes the room — 1 redraw, from the bar at the top.
Cancel: 1 redraw, the strip only.

What is hidden: this chord in this voicing on this tuning (the frets, not the name). A song that voices the chord another way still shows that shape.

Back again: the strip's head counts them (· 11 hidden) and Show hidden lists this page's; Settings has Show all again.

Kept on this reMarkable only.

cost1.text:
Redraws

Pair with your account → the code: 1
Code approved → the shelf: 1
Code expired → new-code page: 1 (the only change it makes by itself)

Nothing ticks: the code's end is a time (14:42), not a countdown.

cost2.text:
Redraws

Open a book, a setlist, a song: 1
Turn a page: 1
A letter: 1 (straight to its page, never paged to)
Sync, on the shelf: 2 small (one line: Syncing… → Synced at)
Sync anywhere else: 0

A tapped row inverts at once (small, fast); the next screen then replaces the page in one redraw.

A setlist's note is the item's own `- note:` in the setlist file (cifra.md §10).

cost3.text:
Redraws

Turn a page: 1
Open the key grid: 1 — the shapes strip only
Choose a key: 1 — chart, strip, key button
Close: 1 — the strip only
In Play, across songs: 1 per turn; the next song's first page is laid out ahead

A shape found late shows on the next page drawn, never by redrawing this one.

cost4.text:
The hard case

The choro book: 21–34 distinct chords a song, 45–95 bars, endings, % repeats, no key property.

One column of bars, four to a row, two chords to a bar.

The strip: at most two rows of eight compact shapes, with the song's own fingers. A page needing more pages the strip: ‹ › in its head turn the strip only — one small redraw; the chart never moves.

Hide shapes (the foot's left): the chart takes the whole page, laid out again from the bar at the top — one redraw. Três Estrelinhas goes from 2 pages to 1. Kept on this reMarkable, for every song.

No key property: the key button names the first chord's key (A for a song opening on A7 — see the reply), and a setlist's key is shown as a note (workflow 12).
